intents.goal: Customers want to see what they searched for. On the search page, show Results for "<what they typed>" above the list and highlight the searched word in the product names.
intents.acceptance: renderSearchPage(products, query) shows the query in a Results for line and wraps the matched text of each product name in <mark>, and npm test passes.
intents.constraints: The page is rendered on the server and sent to the browser as is; src/search.js and test/page.test.js stay as they are.
